sub_graphs.title: EIP-3529: Gas Refund Calculation at Transaction End
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas refund calculation process with reduced refund caps and SSTORE refund changes

nodes.label: Transaction Execution Complete
nodes.description: Transaction has finished executing all opcodes, gas used and refund counter are finalized

nodes.label: Calculate Maximum Refund Cap
nodes.description: Compute max refund as gas_used // MAX_REFUND_QUOTIENT where MAX_REFUND_QUOTIENT = 5

nodes.label: Maximum Refund Cap Determined
nodes.description: Maximum possible refund is calculated as 20% of gas used (gas_used // 5)

nodes.label: Apply Refund Cap
nodes.description: Take minimum of accumulated refund counter and maximum refund cap

nodes.label: Actual Refund Determined
nodes.description: Final refund amount is min(refund_counter, max_refund)

nodes.label: Credit Refund to Sender
nodes.description: Add refunded gas back to sender's remaining gas allocation

nodes.label: Gas Refund Applied
nodes.description: Transaction sender has received gas refund, effective gas used is reduced

edges.label: Take minimum of counter and cap

sub_graphs.title: EIP-3529: SSTORE Refund State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models the different SSTORE refund scenarios with reduced refund values

nodes.label: SSTORE Operation Pending
nodes.description: SSTORE opcode about to execute, current and original values known

nodes.label: Determine Storage Value Transition
nodes.description: Compare current value, new value, and original value to determine refund case

nodes.label: Nonzero to Zero Transition
nodes.description: Storage slot being cleared (nonzero → zero), qualifies for 4800 gas refund

nodes.label: Zero → Nonzero → Zero Transition
nodes.description: Slot set then cleared in same tx, qualifies for 19900 gas refund

nodes.label: Value Reverted to Original
nodes.description: Slot restored to original value, qualifies for 4900 gas refund

nodes.label: No Refund Applicable
nodes.description: Storage transition does not qualify for any refund

nodes.label: Add 4800 Gas to Refund Counter
nodes.description: Add SSTORE_RESET_GAS + ACCESS_LIST_STORAGE_KEY_COST (4800) to refund counter

nodes.label: Add 19900 Gas to Refund Counter
nodes.description: Add refund for zero→nonzero→zero case to refund counter

nodes.label: Add 4900 Gas to Refund Counter
nodes.description: Add refund for reverting to original value to refund counter

nodes.label: SSTORE Operation Complete
nodes.description: Storage write executed, refund counter updated if applicable

sub_graphs.title: EIP-3529: SELFDESTRUCT Refund Removal
sub_graphs.description: Models the removal of gas refund for SELFDESTRUCT operations

nodes.label: SELFDESTRUCT Operation Pending
nodes.description: SELFDESTRUCT opcode about to execute

nodes.label: Execute SELFDESTRUCT
nodes.description: Mark contract for destruction and transfer balance to beneficiary

nodes.label: Contract Marked for Destruction
nodes.description: Contract scheduled for deletion at end of transaction, NO refund added

sub_graphs.title: EIP-3529: Block Gas Limit Validation Impact
sub_graphs.description: Models how reduced refund cap affects maximum block capacity for storage operations

nodes.label: Block Gas Limit Established
nodes.description: Block has a defined gas limit for transaction inclusion

nodes.label: Calculate Maximum Effective Gas
nodes.description: With 20% max refund, max effective gas is limited to 125% of block gas limit

nodes.label: Effective Gas Limit Determined
nodes.description: Maximum possible storage writes bounded by 1.25x block gas limit

nodes.label: Validate Transaction Gas Usage
nodes.description: Ensure transaction stays within effective limits after refund consideration

ambiguities.text: The exact conditions for the 19900 gas refund case are described narratively but complex logic is not explicitly specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the 19900 refund applies when: original_value == 0 AND current_value != 0 AND new_value == 0 (slot was empty, got set, then cleared in same tx).

ambiguities.text: The 28.1% probability threshold for economically rational clearing is an analysis result, not a protocol parameter
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: This is informational context explaining incentive structures, not an enforced protocol rule. The actual refund values are fixed parameters.

implicit_assumptions.description: The reduced refund cap is sufficient to prevent gas token exploitation while preserving legitimate clearing incentives
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the 20% cap is still too high, attackers could still exploit refunds for economic advantage, though with reduced severity compared to 50% cap.

implicit_assumptions.description: Block producers will not be significantly impacted by the reduced maximum effective gas capacity
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Block producers may need to adjust gas estimation algorithms if they previously relied on higher refund exploitation patterns.

implicit_assumptions.description: The EIP-2929/2930 access list costs used in SSTORE_CLEARS_SCHEDULE calculation are correctly integrated
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect integration could lead to refund calculation errors or economic imbalances in storage operations.
